messages:
maria: Heads up — staging publish for release 2026.03.18 failed provenance check between eu-ecr and us-ecr, deploybot put the image on HOLD :flag_eu: :flag_us:
deploybot: deploybot: publish rejected: provenance-check mismatch for manifest sha256:aa11bb... (eu-ecr) vs sha256:cc22dd... (us-ecr) — reason: attestation-subject mismatch. See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1736502468
kevin: @maria can you confirm if this is a retag or the build produced different manifests in parallel regions?
maria: I kicked off the build once; CI reports identical layer digests but the manifest annotation timestamp differs. probably cosign timestamp skew during mirror.
sam: if it's only timestamp in attestation, can we relax that field for staging? risky for prod though. :thinking_face:
jen: we shouldn't relax checks. For staging ok to retag+resign and run canary again. What do we need to retag safely?
kevin: steps I propose:
```
1) pull manifest from eu-ecr: aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name r/inference-staging --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:aa11bb...
2) re-push to us-ecr with same digest-to-tag mapping (retag)
3) run cosign sign --key $STAGING_COSIGN_KEY --annotation buildid=20260318
```
That should produce matching attestations.
maria: noted. I can do 1+2, but need infra approval to use the staging cosign key in eu region.
infra-bot: infra-bot: request recorded: temporary key use for maria (staging-cosign) expires in 1h. Approver: @kevin.
kevin: approved. maria, proceed but push a new tag like `canary-20260318-1` instead of overwriting `staging-latest` so we can roll back cleanly.
maria: doing it now. Will post diffs. :hammer_and_wrench:
deploybot: deploybot: noted new tag `canary-20260318-1` pushed to us-ecr and attestation created.
sam: running a small canary run (5qps) to validate. if green, we can promote. If anything weird, revert to previous pinned digest.
kevin: remind: update release notes to mention retag+resign due to attestation timestamp skew. postmortem if this recurs.
maria: canary passed 10m smoke. logs look normal. I will promote to staging-latest after 15m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
jen: set a 30m change window and notify product. Also create infra ticket to investigate cosign clock skew across mirror agents.
kevin: created INFRA-4512 with logs. tagging this thread. Good run — thanks everyone. :shipit:
